title: Wasn't what I wanted
text: Wasn't what I wanted. It was a plug in and a little bigger than I wanted and when the number "2" is the last number - it is only half shown for some reason.  Alarm isn't the best.  Not worth sending back, kept it for the extra bedroom even though very bright numbers.

features: Durable, impact-proof silicone outer shell protects against minor falls
4” LCD easy-read display with timed, color backlight. Backlight remains illuminated for 5 seconds. Timed feature ensures the backlight will illuminate only when needed and won’t disrupt your sleep
Easy-to-set alarm with large-button snooze function
Portable, take anywhere design makes it perfect for the bedroom, college dorm, workspace, gym or use while traveling
Great alarm clock option for all ages – kids, teenagers and adults. Multiple color options to fit any style
